institution.name: University of Arkansas Community College at Batesville

plan.notes: Source: UACCB 2026-2027 College Catalog, Health Professions section, Technical Certificate Emergency Medical Technology Paramedic. Genuine term-by-term 'Program Course Sequence' (Fall 14 + Spring 16 + Summer 8 = 38) matches the stated credential total 38. Program Prerequisites -- Basic Emergency Medical Technician (EMSC 11007), Essentials of Anatomy and Physiology and Lab (BIOL 10253/BIOL 10151), Medical Terminology (ALHE 10503) -- must be completed before entry and are excluded from the sequenced sum per envelope rules. GENUINE CATALOG GARBLED NOTE kept verbatim: '*May be substituted with Anatomy and Physiology I with Lab (BIOL 24003/BIOL 24001) and Anatomy and Psychology II with Lab (BIOL 10253/BIOL 10151)' -- the catalog prints 'Psychology' where 'Physiology' is meant and reuses BIOL 10253/BIOL 10151 as the Anatomy and Physiology II substitute. Arkansas Department of Health EMT-Basic certification is also required prior to entry.
